guide_enrichment.narrative: For us, the case for Purdue staying closer than the market expects starts with an offense that may be more functional than last season’s baseline suggests. Ryan Browne completed 23 of 29 passes for 317 yards and three touchdowns in the opener, while Purdue finished with 523 total yards and no turnovers. We are not treating one game against Indiana State as proof, especially with 16 first-time Purdue starters and 38 team debuts, but the early production gives our model some reason to resist an especially large margin.
guide_enrichment.matchup_to_watch:
The matchup we are watching is Notre Dame’s rushing offense against Purdue’s run defense. Our efficiency numbers show a major advantage for Notre Dame, and its ability to create scoring opportunities compounds the problem. Purdue recorded eight tackles for loss and three sacks in its opener, but we need to see whether that disruption translates against a much stronger rushing attack.

That is also why our disagreement with the market is not large enough for us to act. Purdue’s offense offers a plausible path to remaining competitive against the spread, but Notre Dame can attack the weakest area in the matchup without becoming one-dimensional. At the available price, we pass.

recent_game.fact: Purdue opened the 2026 season with a 44-19 home victory over Indiana State and produced 523 yards of total offense.
Purdue had no turnovers, won the turnover battle and held Indiana State to 12 first downs.
Sixteen players made their first Purdue starts and 38 players made their Purdue debuts against Indiana State.
Don Saunders returned an interception 35 yards for a touchdown against Indiana State, Purdue's first pick-six since 2022.

opponent_notes.fact: Purdue is scheduled to host Notre Dame for the Shillelagh Trophy on Sept. 26, 2026 at Ross-Ade Stadium.
Notre Dame was ranked No. 4 and had a 1-0 record when this guide was issued.
Purdue lost 56-30 to Notre Dame in 2025, Barry Odom's only prior meeting with the Fighting Irish as Purdue's head coach.

quarterback.fact: Starting quarterback Ryan Browne completed 23 of 29 passes for 317 yards, three touchdowns and no interceptions against Indiana State.
Browne has started 15 games for Purdue and has four career 300-yard passing games.
Browne started all 12 games in 2025 and passed for 2,153 yards and nine touchdowns.
Evans Chuba and Bennett Meredith competed for the backup quarterback role; Meredith started at Northwestern in 2023 but had not played during the previous two seasons.

offensive_personnel.fact: Minnesota transfer Fame Ijeboi led Purdue against Indiana State with 87 rushing yards and one touchdown on 11 carries and added two receptions for 30 yards.
FAU transfer Asaad Waseem caught six passes for 107 yards and one touchdown in his Purdue debut.
Purdue's season-opening offensive line included true freshman Brock Brownfield, the first true freshman to start a Purdue season opener on the line since freshmen became eligible in 1972.
Joey Tanona was the only returning offensive lineman who started all 12 games in 2025; Ethan Trent made six starts and Jude McCoskey played in 11 games.
Purdue added offensive-line transfers Boaz Stanley, Nuku Mafi and Micah Banuelos, who entered 2026 with 21, 12 and five career starts, respectively.
Running back Devin Mockobee graduated after leading Purdue in rushing four times and finishing fourth in program history with 2,987 rushing yards.
Wide receiver Xavier Townsend caught seven passes for 47 yards and returned three punts for 24 yards in his Purdue debut.

defensive_personnel.fact: FIU transfer Mister Clark led Purdue against Indiana State with five solo tackles, two tackles for loss, one sack and one pass breakup.
Linebacker Charles Correa returned after starting all 12 games in 2025 and recording 96 tackles, 7.5 tackles for loss and three sacks.
Purdue added defensive-line transfers Rodney Lora, Curt Neal and Wisdom Simms, who brought a combined 81 games of college experience, including 60 at the Power Four level.
Illinois transfer Jojo Hayden started his Purdue debut and recorded four tackles and one tackle for loss against Indiana State.
Ian Jeffries recorded three tackles and one sack against Indiana State after playing all 12 games with six starts in 2025.

coaching_changes.fact: Kevin Kane returned to Purdue as defensive coordinator and linebackers coach after serving as a Minnesota defensive analyst in 2025; he previously coordinated Purdue's defense in 2023 and 2024.
Zach Crabtree became Purdue's offensive line coach after coaching at Fresno State in 2025.
Cornell Ford moved from wide receivers coach to assistant head coach and running backs coach for 2026.
Bilal Marshall was promoted from offensive analyst to wide receivers coach during the offseason.
Charles Clark joined Purdue as defensive pass game coordinator and defensive backs coach after five seasons at Memphis.

injury_availability.fact: Tight end Kylan Fox suffered an injury at the start of training camp and is expected to miss the 2026 season.
Wide receivers De'Nylon Morrissette and Chauncey Magwood returned after missing the 2025 season with injuries.
Tight end George Burhenn returned against Indiana State after 349 days without game action and caught two passes for 43 yards.

offensive_context.fact: Purdue scored 44 points and gained 523 total yards against Indiana State, its first 500-yard offensive game since Oct. 12, 2024 at Illinois.
All five Purdue players who scored touchdowns against Indiana State recorded their first points as Boilermakers: Tra'Mar Harris, Fame Ijeboi, Chauncey Magwood, Don Saunders and Asaad Waseem.
Purdue added 32 transfers and 22 freshmen for 2026, including 19 transfers from Power Four programs.

defensive_context.fact: Purdue recorded eight tackles for loss and three sacks against Indiana State.
Purdue allowed 284 total yards and 218 passing yards against Indiana State.
Nine of Purdue's 10 defensive linemen listed in the position-group overview weighed at least 300 pounds.

special_teams.fact: True freshman kicker Jacobo Echeverria Lozano made all three field-goal attempts from 39, 27 and 25 yards and converted all five extra points against Indiana State.
Buffalo transfer Dylan Drennan had one 54-yard punt with a 49-yard net in his Purdue debut.
Travis Terrell Jr. entered Purdue after averaging 30 yards per kickoff return with two return touchdowns at Jackson State in 2024.

series_context.fact: Notre Dame leads the series with Purdue 61-26-2 and has won 10 consecutive meetings.

other_relevant.fact: The Notre Dame game is scheduled one week after Purdue's Sept. 19 road game at UCLA, which has an 11 p.m. ET kickoff.
Barry Odom is in his second season as Purdue's head coach after a 2-10 record in 2025.
